subject: Post-call: Security & private deployment scoping for Cerulean Health
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tang <sarah.tang@ceruleanhealth.com>, procurement@ceruleanhealth.com
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Security & private deployment scoping for Cerulean Health

Hi Sarah / Cerulean team —

Great talk earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can scope the Private/VPC/on-prem options you asked about. High-level notes from the call: 
- Cerulean is evaluating Redwood for an inference platform to run PHI-bearing workflows for a subset of clinical assistants.
- Main concerns: SOC 2 status and evidence, HIPAA controls (BAA), network isolation options (VPC peering vs. dedicated on-prem vs. air-gapped), and KMS integration for CME keys.

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) We shared a short vendor security questionnaire (attached) — can you complete the highlighted sections for SOC 2 scope, hosted regions, and encryption/KMS model? (attachment: redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf)
2) Please send any existing security summary/docs Cerulean can share (SOC / ISO / penetration test high-level).
3) We will prepare three architecture sketches (VPC private endpoint, dedicated cluster in your cloud account, and an air-gap on-prem variant) with a short runbook for each. Expect a follow-up with diagrams and effort estimates within 48 business hours after we get your questionnaire answers.
4) Schedule a 45-min technical deep-dive to walk your infra/security team through network/firewall requirements and key-management options — proposed link below.

A couple of clarifications for you to confirm in the questionnaire:
- Is the tenant expected to store persistent KV cache that may include PHI? (affects encryption-at-rest and key rotation model)
- Target SLA / RTO expectations for clinical workflows during business hours?

Attachments: redwood_vendor_security_questionnaire.pdf (fillable)

Thanks — I’ll loop in our security engineer to draft the deployment sketches once we get your answers.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference | Developer-first platform for production LLM serving
From: Sarah Tang <sarah.tang@ceruleanhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@ceruleanhealth.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & private deployment scoping for Cerulean Health

Alex — thanks for the summary and for sending the questionnaire. Notes from our side: 
- SOC 2: Cerulean completed SOC 2 Type II for our core platform in 2025; the report covers patient data flows but does not currently include third-party hosted inference services. We can share a redacted summary (see attached).
- HIPAA/BAA: We need a BAA in place before production access to PHI. Procurement will start the legal intake once you confirm Redwood’s standard BAA template is compatible with on-prem hosting.
- KMS/Keys: We are required to maintain control of keys for PHI in production (customer-managed KMS preferred). For cloud-hosted private deployments, we expect a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) option.
- Air-gapped: We are very interested in an air-gapped option for the initial pilot. Can you confirm what the offline deployment package contains, expected on-site effort, and whether an on-prem engineer from Redwood is required for install?

We attached a short Cerulean security summary and a primary contact for procurement. We will try to complete the questionnaire by end of day Friday (2027-06-04), but procurement may need additional time for legal.

Attachment: cerulean_security_summary_v1.pdf

Thanks,
Sarah Tang
VP, Information Security | Cerulean Health
sarah.tang@ceruleanhealth.com
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & private deployment scoping for Cerulean Health (internal)

Alex / Lauren — quick internal planning notes before we send the diagrams: 
- For BYOK we should offer two modes: cloud KMS integration (customer key) and on-prem HSM integration via PKCS#11 bridge. Document both as supported, call out key rotation responsibilities.
- Network isolation sketches:
  * Option A — VPC private endpoint: minimal infra changes, needs strict SG rules and NAT rules for telemetry; lowest ops friction.
  * Option B — Dedicated cluster in customer cloud account: complete tenancy isolation, recommend dedicated subnet + route tables; we can offer a managed connector for KV cache encryption keys.
  * Option C — Air-gapped appliance: offline OVA + signed container images; requires one of our engineers on-site for first install and initial trust bootstrap.
- For the air-gap runbook we should include: verification checksums, certificate bootstrapping steps, and an abbreviated rollback plan.

I attached a draft diagram set I can annotate and hand off to Lauren for security notes.

Attachment: redwood_private_deploy_options_v1.png

Nikhil
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Tang <sarah.tang@ceruleanhealth.com>, procurement@ceruleanhealth.com
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & private deployment scoping for Cerulean Health

Sarah — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming next steps and a proposed timeline: 
1) Cerulean to return the vendor questionnaire (target: 2027-06-04). Once received, we will finalize the three architecture sketches and an effort estimate (ETA 2 business days).
2) Redwood to provide a preliminary air-gap install statement of work (SOW) and an on-site estimate for engineer days — we will include options for remote-only support vs. on-site.
3) Procurement/legal: I’ll upload Redwood’s standard BAA template to the HubSpot intake (link below) and mark it for legal review; happy to take feedback and iterate.
4) Technical deep-dive: proposed windows — Mon 2027-06-07 10:00-10:45 PT or Tue 2027-06-08 15:00-15:45 PT. Please confirm which works for your infra team.

For transparency: Redwood’s SOC 2 posture — we completed a SOC 2 Type II for our hosted platform in 2026; for Private deployments we run a set of validated configuration checks and can share a prescriptive compliance checklist to map to your audits. We also support BYOK and HSM integrations.

Action items for Cerulean: complete questionnaire + share any diagrams of your proposed isolated subnet/VPN termination. Action items for Redwood: deliver sketches, SOW for air-gap, provide BAA to procurement.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HS-10234
Schedule: https://calendar.redwood.ai/hn/tech-deep-dive-30m

If you confirm the questionnaire timeline and one of the proposed times, I’ll lock the deep-dive and circulate the architecture sketches.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
